start.private: 🐧 Linux Terminal Bot A complete group management bot with a Linux CLI feel, an AI core you can switch on and off, and 8 interface languages. Add me to your group, promote me to admin, and run /settings. Everything is free and the source is public.
start.group: 🐧 Terminal online. Run /help for the command list or /settings for the panel.
help.title: 📖 Command reference Pick a category below.
help.body_admin: 🛡 Moderation /ban — ban a user /tban 10m — ban for a time /sban — silent ban, deletes the command /unban — lift a ban /kick — remove a user /kickme — leave the group /mute — mute a user /tmute 30m — mute for a time /unmute — unmute a user /promote — make admin /demote — take admin back /pin — pin the replied message /unpin — unpin it /purge — delete up to the replied message /del — delete the replied message /info — user card /id — chat and user ids /admins — admin list /link — invite link
help.body_warns: ⚠️ Warnings /warn — warn a user /dwarn — warn and delete their message /unwarn — remove one warning /resetwarn — clear all warnings /warns — show warnings /warnlimit 3 — set the limit /warnmode mute|kick|ban — action at the limit
help.body_notes: 📝 Notes /save name — save the replied message as a note /get name — fetch a note #name — shortcut for /get /notes — list notes /clear name — delete a note
help.body_filters: 🔎 Filters /filter word — reply with a message to auto-answer that word /filters — list filters /stop word — remove a filter
help.body_locks: 🔒 Locks /lock type — lock a content type /unlock type — unlock it /locks — show current locks Types: link, media, photo, video, sticker, gif, forward, mention, voice, document, bots
help.body_greetings: 👋 Greetings /welcome on|off — join messages /goodbye on|off — leave messages /setwelcome text — set the join message /setgoodbye text — set the leave message /cleanservice on|off — delete join and leave service messages Placeholders: {mention}, {first}, {last}, {username}, {id}, {chatname}, {count}
help.body_antiflood: 🌊 Antiflood /antiflood — show the current setting /setflood 10 — act after 10 messages in a row /setflood off — disable it /setfloodmode mute|kick|ban — pick the action
help.body_ai: 🧠 AI terminal core /ai your question — ask the AI /ai on — enable the AI in this chat (admins) /ai off — disable it (admins) The same switch lives in /settings as a button. When the AI is on you can also reply to one of my messages to keep chatting. Answers follow the chat language.
help.body_alias: 👥 Alias packages /alias add devs @user1 @user2 — build a group of users /alias run devs — mention everyone in it /alias del devs — remove the alias /alias list — show all aliases
help.body_misc: 🧰 Misc /start — start the bot /help — this menu /settings — the control panel /lang — change your language /report — call the admins (also works with @admin) /about — about this bot Linux style: whoami, sudo userdel -f @user, clear --terminal
